smallest_supported_claim: In the isolated source-matched R032 run, the native UI created R032 Assignment Camp at absolute OMT [162,36,0], assigned follower character:25 / R032 Establishment Ally 1, and post-save/reload inspection still showed that same actor as CAMP_RESIDENT assigned to [162,36,0]. After reentry, the same camp mission selector and one-worker assignment UI reopened, the saved sorting out the loot priority remained 1, and the follower completed the native organizing-loot work order.
causal_account: The first process began from the declared fresh follower fixture. Native camp dialogue created the camp and assigned the eligible follower. The first game then followed native save/quit and exited code 0; the declared scenario reentry launched generation 1 from the isolated profile. Post-reload native inspection and camp controls independently showed the same camp, follower identity and resident assignment. The ordinary job-priority menu retained sorting out the loot : 1, and the follower's native work menu allowed organizing loot into zones, which completed all possible sorting. The reloaded process was then terminalized through the scenario's sealed journal and finish route; the final save/quit action could not be sent after journal sealing.

citations.meaning: After reentry, the ordinary camp mission selector reopened for the exact camp and faction.
The reopened camp assignment UI still had the same camp and one worker.
The reopened native priority menu retained the sorting job at priority 1.
The native follower work menu choice was activated after reload.
The world observation after the native work choice contains the game messages reporting loot sorting completion; full exact messages are retained in the journal archive and task transcript.
A fresh native NPC inspection after work still identified character:25 as a camp resident assigned to the same absolute camp OMT.
